consistency_findings: Table 2 contains both positive and null/inverse study estimates; these were preserved rather than reconciled because they reflect distinct cited studies.
The review mixes genotype-defined CYP2D6 status and drug-induced inhibition as related but nonidentical mechanisms; atoms preserve the source wording and comparison groups.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated guideline/recommendation or secondary-review atom kind. Review recommendations were encoded as author_conclusion with guidance_recommendation tags.

The schema has no explicit field for citation-under-review provenance when a secondary source reproduces primary-study results; these are tagged secondary_reported_result and anchored to Table 2 of this review.
extraction_limitations: This is a narrative/review article rather than primary literature, so the ATOM schema is not a perfect semantic fit.
Table 1 allele-frequency cells were not atomized individually; the table was reconciled in SEA and represented at the review-synthesis level.
Table 3 individual drug cells were not each emitted as separate atoms; clinically load-bearing categories and key drug assertions were atomized, while the full classification is preserved in SEA.
